ValidationRule.description: Prevents users to set order status related to the integration with SAP manually
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR (AND( OR (ISPICKVAL(Status, "SentToSAP"),ISPICKVAL(Status, "Activated")), NOT(chk_BypassValidation__c), ISCHANGED(Status), OR(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Activated"), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(Status), "OrderReceivedBySAP")) ) , AND( OR (ISPICKVAL(Status, "OrderReceivedBySAP"),ISPICKVAL(Status, "Activated")), NOT(chk_BypassValidation__c), ISCHANGED(Status), OR (ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Activated"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "SentToSAP" )) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot set this status manually
